g.text: Separate experiments: the panels use different seeds, policies and references.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b677a

g.text: A: turnover differs in the original screen; matched turnover uses amended common growth. Do not pool them.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b677a

g.text: B: all five arms use common growth and a fixed deletion schedule. Both trace candidates fail the expansion rule.
